contract: Positive rational law, total weight1, exact coordinate means p, binary atoms, frozen p=0/1 coordinates, supplied partition quotas, support<=n+1, independently recomputed exact per-atom max row error. No probabilistic theorem transplanted from GSW.
hybrid_sign_contract: Cube paired signs: all row sums squared <8*r*s, r=ceil(log2(2R)); partition signs: squared <16*r*s; exact original rational D checked. Failure/nonbinary/threshold rejection triggers existing exact N24 signer, logged and charged.
proposal_budget: Eight proposals per signing for GSW/greedy/random variants; maximum max(4*t,1) walk steps per proposal. All complete case/method processes have20s wall ceiling including import, construction, checking and serialization. Early termination is retained; no retries discarded.
global_exact_small: Only n<=8; enumerate every face/quota-feasible Boolean vertex; minimise worst supported atom error by threshold convex-hull feasibility. Claim optimum only with exact positive rational primal law and exact separating certificate for immediately preceding threshold.
systematic: Shared-uniform threshold law in cube; cumulative systematic sampling within each quota block using shared U; exact breakpoint enumeration.
dependent_greedy: Exact pipage branching along within-block pairs; cube gets a dummy coordinate to make total sum integral. Choose fractional pairs with smallest supplied feature-column L-infinity separation. Compress at every round. Full branching probabilities exact; no sampled law masquerades as exact means.
acceptance: All failed/timed-out outcomes remain denominators. Primary evidence is complete-law validity plus actual discrepancy/cost Pareto comparisons; source moment envelope recorded separately. No universal advantage or discovery inference from these finite families.
heldout_policy: Implement and debug on development first. No parameter/variant tuning after heldout outcomes are read. Implementation repairs, if necessary, retain all preceding failures and hashes.
